newsitem.title: USA: Wash Mutual says no plans to raise bid.
newsitem.headline: Wash Mutual says no plans to raise bid.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc said Monday it was not considering raising its offer for Great Western Financial Corp and was confident its definitive agreement with Great Western would prevail.
Hostile bidder H.F. Ahmanson raised its exchange offer to between 1.10 and 1.20 Ahmanson share from 1.05 share.

"Ahmanson's hostile actions do not alter the conclusion the Washington Mutual/Great Western combination will provide a stronger more finanically sound company in terms of tangible capital, credit quality and potential earnings power," said a Washington Mutual spokesman said.

"Under our merger agreement, our transaction is to be considerd by the shareholders at the earliest possible date and we're confident they'll approve the Great Westen/Washington Mutual combination," the spokesman said.
Washington Mutual Inc reached a definitive merger agreement with Great Western on March 6, to swap 0.9 of its shares for each Great Western share.
The spokesman said no date has yet been set for a shareholder vote on the deal.
